title: HUANet: Hard-Constrained Unrolled ADMM for Constrained Convex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2604.13179v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper presents HUANet, a constrained deep neural network architecture that unrolls the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) into a trainable neural network for accelerating parametric constrained convex optimization. Existing end-to-end learning methods operate as black-box mappings from parameters to solutions, often without explicitly incorporating optimality principles or guaranteeing constraint satisfaction. To address these limitations, HUANet embeds a hard-constrained neural network within each unrolled ADMM iteration, where a differentiable correction stage enforces the affine equalities of the primal subproblem. Furthermore, we incorporate first-order optimality conditions into a self-supervised training loss to promote the convergence of the proposed unrolled algorithm. translated_title: HUANet：用于约束凸优化的硬约束展开式ADMM
translated_abstract: 本文提出了HUANet，一种约束式深度神经网络架构，它将交替方向乘子法（ADMM）展开为可训练的神经网络，用于加速参数化约束凸优化问题。现有的端到端学习方法作为从参数到解的黑盒映射运行，通常没有显式融入最优性原则，也无法保证约束满足。为解决这些局限性，HUANet在每个展开的ADMM迭代中嵌入一个硬约束神经网络，其中可微的校正阶段强制执行原始子问题的仿射等式约束。此外，我们将一阶最优性条件纳入自监督训练损失中，以促进所提出的展开算法的收敛。针对基准优化问题和控制应用的大量数值实验证明并验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: HUANet将ADMM展开为硬约束神经网络，在每个迭代中通过可微校正阶段强制满足仿射等式约束，并将一阶最优性条件纳入自监督训练损失以促进收敛，从而加速参数化约束凸优化。
en_tdlr: HUANet unrolls ADMM into a hard-constrained neural network that enforces affine equality constraints via a differentiable correction stage at each iteration and incorporates first-order optimality conditions into a self-supervised training loss to promote convergence, thereby accelerating parametric constrained convex optimization.
